paper.title: Your Code Agent Can Grow Alongside You with Structured Memory
paper.central_claim: MemCoder通过结构化历史人类commit、上下文检索和验证驱动自精炼，将人类验证的新解留存为长期记忆，支持持续人机协同演化，并在SWE-bench Verified达到SOTA及DeepSeek-V3.2 resolved rate提升9.4个百分点。

provenance.notes: 按已配置 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol 执行；环境声明为 gpt-6.1-sol，但无独立运行收据/会话标识，actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref 留 null，不额外探测。未访问其他席/attempt/批次或前3篇输出；未联网，未运行论文代码。

sections_read: all available appendices, algorithms, prompt templates and tables
materials.notes: 固定HTML转文本完整阅读；无 manifest page_images，图内未转出的数值不臆造。完整材料不意味着作者报告充分。

evidence.quote: MemCoder first structures historical human experience to distill latent intent-to-code mappings from past commits. It then employs a self-refinement mechanism driven by verification feedback to correct agent behavior in real-time. Crucially, an experience self-internalization mechanism is introduced to crystallize human-validated solutions into long-term knowledge, thereby supporting sustained evolution.
evidence.support_explanation: 保留原始持续协同演化主张，不能事后缩成单次RAG。

evidence.quote: In contrast to these rigid or decay-based structures, MemCoder introduces a flat, autonomous memory management paradigm that dynamically integrates new insights.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对树/遗忘记忆定位；本文实际算法主要追加，不是丰富编辑策略。

evidence.quote: Through iterative invocation, the Refining Sub-agent updates its verification logic by reconciling execution feedback with retrieved successful precedents, allowing the agent to deepen its understanding of the codebase and generate higher-quality, repository-aligned code without modifying long-term memory during execution.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行期自精炼只改当期checklist，不改变长期memory。

evidence.quote: Unlike historical commits, these experiences originate from model-generated solutions and human validation, enabling the memory to gradually shift from human-only priors to human–agent co-evolved knowledge.
evidence.support_explanation: 人类验证新解写入是主张中的闭环，尚需后续任务实验。

evidence.quote: The benchmark poses significant repository-level challenges, requiring agents to reason over entire codebases, handle complex cross-file dependencies, and generate functional code patches to resolve bugs or implement features. Evaluation is performed by executing generated patches against unit test suites, emphasizing functional correctness rather than textual similarity
evidence.support_explanation: 官方执行型测量而非文本自评。

evidence.quote: To improve evaluation efficiency, we conduct our experiments on SWE-bench Verified, a manually curated, high-quality subset of 500 task instances widely used by existing baselines.
evidence.support_explanation: 500任务分母明确。

evidence.quote: To ensure a fair evaluation and prevent temporal leakage, we strictly restrict the agent at test time to retrieve only historical experiences created prior to the corresponding test issue.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确检索时间截止，但不等同于新写memory对以后任务的独立审计。

signatures.object: 长期memory M及k+p检索向量索引；原始commit message/patch加问题、根因和方案
signatures.information: 历史人类commit含原message及代码diff，agent查询时只允许当前issue之前的历史；这些不是当前issue的答案权限
signatures.operation: LLMPolish构建sextuple(o,c,k,p,r,s)，embedding(k+p)入FAISS，ANN候选再cross-encoder重排，agent按状态调用retrieval
signatures.output: 语义重构的先例与可操作经验，供主agent/RefiningAgent上下文使用
signatures.conditions: 历史commit可用且时间过滤；生成根因解释需忠实但无人工逐条核验报告
signatures.feedback: 历史已提交人类修复与任务执行反馈
signatures.selection_rule: 新commit未在M中才同步；检索ANN+reranker评分，不是逐entry效用门
signatures.selection_data: 项目历史与当前问题描述，不报告直接看未来issue解
signatures.persistence: M追加条目与embedding，下一run增量同步
signatures.later_use: 后续issue自主查询与检索经验指导实现/测试
signatures.claimed_effect: DS pass1由342/500至389/500，结构化优于raw history
signatures.failure_boundary: 缺去重/冲突/遗忘/版本回滚；相似度与LLM语义不保证可迁移因果

signatures.object: 当期验证测试、checklist及通过人类审核后的新经验
signatures.information: issue、候选patch、执行上下文、环境测试反馈、检索历史；官方benchmark tests用于最终测量，不假称提前给子agent
signatures.operation: RefiningAgent生成复现/回归测试与具体清单，失败则反馈主agent；通过后人类review并GitCommit，新commit下一run进入M
signatures.output: 修复patch、当期checklist与长期新commit经验
signatures.conditions: 算法成功标记后经HumanReview；主agent选择调用；没有自动高置信无审查留存
signatures.feedback: 执行测试+环境观测+人类验证
signatures.selection_rule: generated test pass用于当期完成判定，人类review用于正式commit；不是独立留出提高才写入
signatures.selection_data: 当前issue及历史，不给新提交在后续任务上的配对效用测试
signatures.persistence: 执行时M不变；提交后下次Stage1再学习
signatures.later_use: 算法声称下一run使用；实验没有分离关闭新写入的stream对照
signatures.claimed_effect: 持续人机共同演化，DSR pass1增7/500
signatures.failure_boundary: 人类审核成本与一致性未量化；长期协同主张弱于一次snapshot基准证据

rationale: 历史commit结构化、检索和测试清单消融支持SWE修复提升；人审写回next-run接口明确。原主张的持续共演化无新写入流式验证，预算、统计及污染审计不足，结论限定为历史记忆复用。
